purpose: Appendix-ready follow-up for GeoExplorer-anchor0624 gate-floor dense sweep, validation-distance checkpoint-selection bias, strict reward endpoint controls, and fine-grained reward gate-function ablation.

reuse_from_first_appendix_round.note: This follow-up trains only missing cells. Final paper curves should merge the completed first-round anchor points with these new rows.

rigor_notes: GATE_FLOOR=0 and GATE_FLOOR=1 are gate endpoint controls, not pure external or pure intrinsic reward.
Strict external-only control uses GEOEXPLORER_REWARD=ex and GEOEXPLORER_PBRS_COEF=0.00.
Strict intrinsic-only control uses GEOEXPLORER_REWARD=intrinsic_only and GEOEXPLORER_PBRS_COEF=0.00; this requires the compatible branch added to train.py.
Fixed-parameter intrinsic reward uses GEOEXPLORER_GATE_MODE=constant; this is a backward-compatible mode added only for the new fine-grained reward table.
Reward gate-type rows keep external reward on and compare each intrinsic schedule with and without PBRS where applicable.
Validation-distance rows test checkpoint-selection bias; use per-distance d4-d8 results, not only mean SR.

deployment_policy.start_after: Wait for anchor0624_dataset_param_appendix_seed321_480k to complete, then launch this package.
deployment_policy.concurrency: Use GPU0/1/2/3 after the current first-round experiment has finished.
